name: Old Testament Law
overview: The Old Testament Law, given through Moses, reveals God's holy standards and exposes human sinfulness, as Paul explains that without the law, sin would not be known (Romans 7:7). Jesus affirmed that He did not come to abolish the law but to fulfill it, fulfilling all that was written concerning Him in the law, prophets, and psalms (Matthew 5:17; Luke 24:44). While believers are delivered from the law's condemnation and now serve God in the newness of the Spirit rather than the old letter (Romans 7:6), Christ remains the culmination of the law, bringing righteousness to all who believe (Romans 10:4). Jeremiah anticipates a new covenant that God will establish, pointing forward to the fulfillment found in Christ (Jeremiah 31:31).
